item.title: Career criminal charged with attacking Chicago TV reporter
item.description: A man has been charged with attacking a Chicago television news reporter as she sat in an SUV in Chicago's Loop last month, with the attack resulting in the victim suffering a detached salivary gland and other injuries.

item.title: Corrections officer charged as Cook County steps up effort to stop drug-laced jail mail
item.description: Cook County officials have revealed a new method of drug smuggling involving books and have invested over $2 million in new drug detection technology to combat the flow of narcotics into the jail.

item.title: 14-year-old girl shot, man found dead in Kendall County home
item.description: Officials in Kendall County are investigating after a teenage girl was shot and a man was found dead at a home in unincorporated Oswego Township.

item.title: Curling Controversy: A breakdown of the accusations levied at the Winter Olympics
item.description: World Curling reversed its decision to increase monitoring of Olympic curling matches after athletes expressed dissatisfaction with the increased surveillance, and the governing body concluded that double-touching was a minor infraction.

item.title: Tom Pritzker steps down as executive chairman of Hyatt Hotels
item.description: Tom Pritzker, Executive Chairman of Hyatt Hotels Corporation, is stepping down from his role with the company, citing the need for good stewardship and regret over his association with Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.
